values.note: ReserveAmerica lists 10 Asaph Campground sites (001-010), all drive-in pull-in (not pull-through). Sites 003, 007, 008 and 010 list a 30-ft max vehicle length, 006 25 ft, 001 and 009 20 ft; 002, 004 and 005 list none (pads 15-20 ft). The Asaph loop's roadside, hike-in and equestrian sites are separate.

sites.source: Tioga State Forest site list on pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com (parkId 880260) and each Asaph Campground site page (Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry, Site Length), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 'Effective January 1, 2024: The Asaph and County Bridge Campgrounds must be reserved through the Pennsylvania State Parks and Forests Reservation website. On site (honor envelopes) registration is no longer offered.' Seven-night limit; check-in and check-out 3 pm.

booking.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-forests/find-a-forest/tioga/camping ('Effective January 1, 2024: The Asaph and County Bridge Campgrounds must be reserved ...', 'Stays are limited to seven nights at a motorized, roadside campsite') + https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/what-to-do/stay-overnight/motorized-roadside-camping ('reserved 11 months in advance to noon of the day of arrival'), read 2026-10-20

note: Developed drive-in state forest campground (Tioga State Forest) along Asaph Run near Gaines. 10 sites with picnic tables, fire rings and non-flush toilets; four of them list a 30-ft max vehicle length, the rest 25 ft or less. No hookups, water or dump station. Must be reserved through the PA reservation system (since January 2024; on-site honor registration has ended). --Claude
summary: Confirmed no hookups, non-flush (vault) toilets, reservable on ReserveAmerica 11 months ahead to noon, 7-night limit. Changed site count 16 -> 10 (the booking site lists Asaph Campground 001-010; 16 is the whole Asaph loop with its roadside and equestrian sites) and corrected the note; added max 30 ft (four sites), no pull-throughs, reservation required, open year round, no showers/water/dump. Fees left as recorded (DCNR state forest rate).
